duration: Indefinite duration, subject to a 90-day probationary period from the start date.

financial_value.payment_terms: Monthly salary, paid at the end of each calendar month. NOTE: This is the correct amount per the prevailing Arabic version; the English version incorrectly states AED 16,000 (see data/ground_truth/discrepancies.json).

termination_clauses: Either party may terminate with 30 days' prior written notice.
The Employer may terminate immediately without notice for proven gross misconduct by the Employee.
penalty_clauses: No specific financial penalties; end-of-service benefits apply per the UAE Federal Labour Law.
governing_law: Laws of the United Arab Emirates; exclusive jurisdiction of the Dubai Courts.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
